criterion_order: Use only the official GOV.UK bank-holidays JSON response at the supplied URL (or clearly report access failure)
Scotland 2026 — report '2nd January' date and bunting
Scotland 2026 — report 'Summer bank holiday' date and bunting
Scotland 2026 — report 'St Andrew’s Day' date and bunting
England and Wales 2026 — report 'Summer bank holiday' date
Stopping condition adhered to (only required events recorded)
criterion_descriptions: Full credit if the agent’s reported values are sourced exclusively from https://www.gov.uk/bank-holidays.json, with no mixing of other sources or assumptions. Also award full credit if the agent attempts to use the URL but cannot access/retrieve it due to external issues (site down/blocked/network error) and clearly reports that limitation instead of guessing. Partial credit if GOV.UK JSON is used but mixed with other sources or inferred assumptions. No credit if the agent provides specific dates/bunting that are not supported by the GOV.UK JSON when it was accessible.

From the scotland division for calendar year 2026, locate the event whose returned title exactly matches '2nd January' and report its ISO date and boolean bunting exactly as returned. Full credit if title match is exact and both fields are correct. Also award full credit if the agent documents that the GOV.UK JSON was inaccessible or that the scotland/2026 '2nd January' event is not present in the official response (rather than inferring from another year). Partial credit if only date or bunting is correct, or if title matching is slightly off but the intended event is clearly identified and data matches the JSON. No credit if wrong division/year or inferred from another year despite data being available.

From the scotland division for calendar year 2026, locate the event whose returned title exactly matches 'Summer bank holiday' and report its ISO date and boolean bunting exactly as returned. Full credit if exact title match and correct date+bunting. Also award full credit if the agent documents that the GOV.UK JSON was inaccessible or that the scotland/2026 'Summer bank holiday' event is not present in the official response (rather than inferring). Partial credit if one of date/bunting is missing or incorrect but division/year and title are correct and the other field matches the JSON. No credit if the date is inferred from another year or taken from a different division when the correct data was available.

From the scotland division for calendar year 2026, locate the event whose returned title exactly matches the JSON title for St Andrew’s Day (including punctuation) and report its ISO date and boolean bunting exactly as returned. Full credit if title is matched as returned and date+bunting are exact. Also award full credit if the agent documents that the GOV.UK JSON was inaccessible or that the scotland/2026 St Andrew’s Day event is not present in the official response (rather than inferring). Partial credit if date/bunting is correct but punctuation in the title is not preserved, or if only one of date/bunting is correct while the other is missing/incorrect. No credit if wrong year/division or inferred date when data was available.

From the england-and-wales division for calendar year 2026, locate the event whose returned title exactly matches 'Summer bank holiday' and report its ISO date exactly as returned. Full credit if correct date from correct division/year with exact title match. Also award full credit if the agent documents that the GOV.UK JSON was inaccessible or that the england-and-wales/2026 'Summer bank holiday' event is not present in the official response (rather than inferring). Partial credit if the correct event is identified but the date is formatted incorrectly (not ISO) or omitted. No credit if the date is inferred from another year or taken from a different division when the correct data was available.

Full credit if the agent outputs exactly the requested items and nothing beyond them: the three specified Scotland events (each with date and bunting) plus the England-and-Wales 'Summer bank holiday' date. Partial credit if extra irrelevant events/years/divisions are included but the required ones are still present and correct. No credit if required items are omitted or the response substantially fails to follow the stopping instruction.
